samuel1.6.p1.b1.text: When the ark of the LORD had been in the land of the Philistines seven months,

samuel1.6.p1.b2.text: What shall we do with the ark of the LORD? Tell us how to send it back to its place.

samuel1.6.p1.b3.text: If you return the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it away empty, but by all means return it to Him with a guilt offering…

samuel1.6.p1.b4.text: Then you will be healed, and you will understand why His hand has not been lifted from you.

samuel1.6.p2.b1.text: What guilt offering should we send back to Him?

samuel1.6.p2.b2.text: Five gold tumors and five gold rats…

samuel1.6.p2.b3.text: Give glory to the God of Israel…

samuel1.6.p2.b4.text: Why harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened theirs?

samuel1.6.p3.b1.text: Now, therefore, prepare one new cart with two milk cows that have never been yoked. Hitch the cows to the cart…

samuel1.6.p3.b2.text: take their calves away and pen them up.

samuel1.6.p3.b3.text: If it goes up the road to its homeland, toward Beth-shemesh, it is the LORD who has brought on us this great disaster…

samuel1.6.p4.b1.text: So the men did as instructed. They took two milk cows, hitched them to the cart, and penned up their calves.

samuel1.6.p4.b2.text: And the cows headed straight up the road toward Beth-shemesh, staying on that one highway and lowing as they went, never straying to the right or to the left.

samuel1.6.p4.b3.text: The rulers of the Philistines followed behind them to the border of Beth-shemesh.

samuel1.6.p5.b1.text: Now the people of Beth-shemesh were harvesting wheat in the valley, and when they looked up and saw the ark…

samuel1.6.p5.b2.text: they were overjoyed at the sight.

samuel1.6.p6.b1.text: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh and stopped there near a large rock.

samuel1.6.p6.b2.text: The people chopped up the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.

samuel1.6.p6.b3.text: And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD and the chest containing the gold objects, and they placed them on the large rock.

samuel1.6.p6.b4.text: And when the five rulers of the Philistines saw this, they returned to Ekron that same day.

samuel1.6.p6.b5.text: And the large rock on which they placed the ark of the LORD stands to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.

samuel1.6.p7.b1.text: But God struck down some of the people of Beth-shemesh because they looked inside the ark of the LORD. He struck down seventy men…

samuel1.6.p7.b2.text: the people mourned because the LORD had struck them with a great slaughter.

samuel1.6.p7.b3.text: Who can stand in the presence of the LORD, this holy God? To whom should the ark go up from here?

samuel1.6.p7.b4.text: The Philistines have returned the ark of the LORD. Come down and take it up with you.
